events.title: Destruction Snake Demo – A Major New Update
events.summary: Dear players,Thank you. Every one of you who has played this game means a great deal to me.This is an important update for Destruction Snake. Over the past period, I have been working hard to make the game more fun and to give its gameplay more depth.A large amount of new content and several new mechanics have been added in this update.
